scientific_integrity: The infinite classification is proved directly from the exact valuation update \(m\mapsto m-1+\nu_p(m)\). Finite computation is used only as a regression check and is not treated as proof of the infinite cases.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to a single-prime arithmetic partial derivative on integers; it does not classify the full arithmetic derivative, multi-prime subderivatives, or arbitrary local-field orbits.
title: Sharp valuation phase diagram for arithmetic partial derivatives
